publicationDecision.authorisation: Standing Medicines Watch instruction: supported factual additions and corrections may go live without repeat permission.
publicationDecision.scope: Publish five primary-source-reviewed research omissions through the guarded workflow; this is editorial authorisation, not clinical approval.

reviewType: AI-assisted primary-source factual review; not clinical approval

entries.name: ARO-ALK7
entries.summary: Arrowhead's current pipeline records a recruiting first-in-human study in adults with obesity. It evaluates ARO-ALK7 alone and, separately, with tirzepatide; an estimated completion date is not treated as completed research.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for this programme or formulation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development or a registry listing does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: Recruiting status and sponsor descriptions are not results. Preclinical body-composition findings do not establish human efficacy, muscle function or future approval, and the cited pipeline's July 2026 estimated completion date is not proof that the study completed.

entries.name: MWN105 injection
entries.stage: Completed Phase 2 registry; no results posted
entries.summary: The sponsor-submitted registry records a Chinese Phase 2 study of once-weekly subcutaneous MWN105 in 120 non-diabetic participants with overweight or obesity. It started on 3 September 2025 and completed on 16 April 2026.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for this programme or formulation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development or a registry listing does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: Completed registry status does not mean results have been published or establish efficacy. No results are posted, and the registry does not establish the medicine's mechanism, authorisation or availability.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07804810
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted registry record read for completed Phase 2 status, actual dates, 120-participant enrolment, weekly injection design and absence of posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

entries.name: IBI3032 tablets
entries.stage: Completed Phase 1 registry; no results posted
entries.summary: The sponsor-submitted registry records a completed Chinese Phase 1 study of oral IBI3032 tablets: single ascending doses in healthy participants and four weeks of multiple ascending doses in participants with overweight or obesity.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for this programme or formulation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development or a registry listing does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: The 80-participant study completed on 10 August 2026, but no results are posted. Completion does not establish efficacy, a later development stage, authorisation, access or supply.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07160400
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted registry record read for completed Phase 1 status, oral formulation, actual dates, 80-participant enrolment and absence of posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

entries.name: HDM1005 injection
entries.summary: The sponsor-submitted registry records a recruiting Chinese Phase 2 study comparing three once-weekly HDM1005 dose groups with tirzepatide in adults with obesity without diabetes. Actual study start was 31 March 2026; estimated enrolment is 372.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for this programme or formulation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development or a registry listing does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: A comparator arm is not evidence of superiority. Recruitment, estimated July 2027 completion and planned 52-week treatment do not establish completed results, authorisation or supply.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07521631
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted registry record read for recruiting Phase 2 status, actual start, comparator design, estimated enrolment and completion, and absence of posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

entries.name: NPM-139 semaglutide implant
entries.summary: The sponsor-submitted SLIM-1 registry record describes a four-week Phase 1 comparison of a subcutaneous semaglutide implant with weekly Wegovy injections in 20 participants with overweight or obesity.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for this programme or formulation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development or a registry listing does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: The record remained not yet recruiting at its 30 June 2026 update even though the estimated start was July 2026. Planned dates and a registered comparison are not first dosing, results, UK authorisation or evidence of supply.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07430059
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted registry record read for not-yet-recruiting Phase 1 status, implant formulation, planned 20-participant design, estimated dates and absence of posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

discoveryLimitations.currentDatePass: No new UK MHRA, NICE or NHS authorisation/access decision was found in the current-date pass for these five programmes.
discoveryLimitations.plannedVersusCompleted: MWN105 and IBI3032 are registry-completed with no posted results; HDM1005 and ARO-ALK7 are recruiting; NPM-139 remains not yet recruiting. None is described as a completed successful treatment programme.
discoveryLimitations.monitoring: No automatic monitoring source, successful baseline, review renewal or all-green claim is created by this publication.
discoveryLimitations.monitorFailures: The separate source-availability pass found two Pfizer HTTP 520 failures, one AstraZeneca HTTP 403 failure and a renewed intermittent PMC missing-document failure. These remain visible and do not alter reviewed claims.
discoveryLimitations.coverage: The catalogue remains selected and non-exhaustive; these five additions do not establish industry completeness.
